-- Step 1: Create the archive table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interactions_archive AS 
SELECT * FROM interactions WHERE FALSE;

-- Step 2: Move old records (Inactive status + Basic membership) to archive
WITH matching_records AS (
    SELECT i.activity_reg, i.time_mark, i.interact_fan_pivot, i.interact_idol_pivot,
           i.act_kind, i.act_plat, i.plat_used, i.dev_type, i.app_ver,
           i.sess_dur_min, i.live_att, i.watch_hrs, i.gift_metrics, i.chat_activity,
           i.engagement_rate, i.gift_rate, i.message_rate, i.content_consumption_rate
    FROM interactions i
    JOIN fans f ON i.interact_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
    WHERE f.status_tag = 'Inactive' 
      AND m.memb_kind = 'Basic'
)
INSERT INTO interactions_archive
SELECT * FROM matching_records;

-- Step 3: Delete the moved records from the main table
DELETE FROM interactions
WHERE activity_reg IN (
    SELECT mr.activity_reg
    FROM matching_records mr
);

-- Verify the results
SELECT 'Archive count' as metric, COUNT(*) as count FROM interactions_archive
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Remaining interactions', COUNT(*) FROM interactions;
